# base-themes (vendor excerpt)

Light **data-dense** design tokens adapted from [markbang/base-themes](https://github.com/markbang/base-themes) (MIT).

HARDGATE uses `data-style="data-dense"` and `data-theme="light"` on `<html>`; tokens live in `tokens-data-dense-light.css` and map into HARDGATE `--ink`, `--panel`, etc. via `bright.css`.
